page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left page with running head and page number at top, one text column, a marginal reference "Cap. 27." at left margin below the text; right page shows only the cut-off edge of the neighbouring text column (not transcribed as it is the edge of another page). Page number 104 at top left.

main_text.l: personae ipsius: at non poteft quis
non poteft actu suo obligare spiri-
autem dixi in responsione ad dubi-
um in hoc casu jurantem ordina-
rie obligari: id propterea dixi, quia
fieri poteft ut interdum non obli-
getur. Nam cum de jurantis inten-
tione, ex natura rei & materiae sub-
ubi ex natura rei promissae & aliis
cui juravit, et non successoribus e-
XI. Sed de Causis Agentibus haec
quis ex mero motu propriae voluntatis

page.notes: Left-page text is in a small, worn scan; several words are doubtful, e.g. "seipsum" for "fe ipfum" and "praesumi" for "promisi"; the transcription of the first paragraph follows the printed words as closely as legible. The final word of the last line "tatis" is printed at the right edge, and the right page is only partly visible (fragments "tatis", "fe a", "petu", etc.), not transcribed.
